name: Input Mask
tagline: Type into a pattern — phone numbers, postal codes, IDs — and the column keeps its shape.
summary:
Formats a text column as it is typed: `5551234567` becomes `(555) 123-4567`, and characters a slot does not take are refused. It replaces the platform's own Input Mask control, which was deprecated in 2023.

- Keeps the cursor in place when typing, deleting or pasting in the middle of a value
- Shows values already in the column in the mask, and leaves the ones it cannot show as saved
- Marks an unfinished value as incomplete without discarding what was typed
- Stores either the formatted value or the typed characters alone

presets.name: US phone
presets.description: A stored raw number, shown in the mask. Click into it and type, delete across the ) — the cursor stays where you are.

presets.name: Empty, with the guide
presets.description: Focus the empty field and the guide shows the shape. Type a few digits and click away to see the incomplete message.

presets.name: Canadian postal code
presets.description: A9A 9A9: letters are made upper-case as you type.

presets.name: Custom pattern
presets.description: AA-9999, a maker's own pattern: two upper-case letters, a literal dash, four digits.

presets.name: Stored raw
presets.description: Store raw: the column gets the digits alone while the field still shows the mask — watch getOutputs.

presets.name: A value that does not fit
presets.description: A seven-digit local number saved before the mask. It is shown exactly as saved with a note; click in to see it in the mask, click away and it is back; nothing is written until you type.
